evidence: Touches src/wallet/migration.cpp and src/wallet/walletdb.*, modifying the legacy-to-descriptor SQLite migration logic.
rationale: Avoids redundant disk I/O during legacy wallet migration and deletes dead record-erasure functions. The PR changes migration to filter legacy and transaction records before writing rather than writing and immediately deleting them, enabling the removal of several unused database methods like EraseTx and EraseRecords.
